reviews.title: Ad after Ad after Ad
reviews.text:
Frustrating & Misleading

I’m extremely disappointed with Unscrew Frenzy 3D. The amount of advertising is excessive, especially after you’ve already paid to remove ads.

What makes it even more frustrating is that if you want to add just one additional box, you’re forced to watch an advertisement and it’s not even a short ad. These ads can be extremely long and completely interrupt the gameplay experience.

So what exactly is the point of paying to remove ads if the game still forces you to watch advertisements to access certain features? Paying to remove ads should mean just that: no ads, not “no ads unless you want to use a certain feature.”

I enjoy the concept of the game, but the aggressive advertising and the way the ad-removal purchase is handled make the experience incredibly frustrating. I would not recommend spending money on ad removal until this is changed.

I’m sorry, that’s still an ad. Oh, and don’t even get me started on the $FREE $7.99 a week subscription. I might pay that once to remove all ads forever, but a week? There are so many other games thar are WAY better than this one. Even if I have to watch an ad or 2 that go away very quickly, it’s way better than this game. reviews.title: Too time consuming with bad ads
reviews.text: Spent way too much time trying to move ahead in this game.  You can get up to 50 coins by winning a game, but the tokens that you need to progress through the game is a minimum of 100 coins, and you will need those to advance through the game.  Spinning the wheel daily and playing challenges can yield you prizes, but they come at a cost, such as watching very long ads, many lasting over 1 minute or a couple that don’t allow you to advance through the ad at all.   I sent them an email to complain about a broken ad and got no response.   If you want to play it for a few laughs then I hope you have fun with it, but this game is not based on logic, and you can easily spends your tokens or coins to find the bolts which are often buried deep.  IF you’re competitive (I.e. always want to be at the top) or have an addictive personality, then avoid this game at all costs, as you will spend hours playing this game and not get anything else done.
